name: Whispering Glade
teaser: The leaves are gossiping about you.
flavor: Old trees here repeat everything they've ever heard.

text.success: learn one tag from a rival's mission.
text.fail: the trees laugh at you; lose 1 stamina.
text.spark: also see the next World card.

name: Glowcap Hollow
teaser: Something down there is glowing.
flavor: A dip in the forest floor carpeted with mushrooms that glow when you breathe on them.

text.fail: wrong mushroom; you're a frog until your next turn.

text.spark: see the full card behind both teasers next turn.

name: The Woodcutter's Camp
teaser: Smoke, and the smell of stew.
flavor: An abandoned camp, still warm. Someone left in a hurry.

text.fail: a raccoon bites you; lose 1 health.
text.spark: also a Sturdy Axe (gear: +1 die on Brawn rolls at Forest locations).

name: Mossback Tortoise Crossing
teaser: A hill that blinks.
flavor: A tortoise the size of a cottage is crossing the path. It has been crossing for three days.

text.success: befriend Old Mossback (companion: once per game, ignore all damage from one source).
text.spark: he carries you; draw 3 teasers next turn instead of 2.

text.success: Restore 2 stamina. Roll 1 die: on a 1, you waited all day and lose your quick action this turn.

name: The Bramblewood
teaser: The path closes behind you.
flavor: Thorny vines shift whenever no one is looking, and small eyes watch from inside them.

text.spark: also a Bramble Cloak (gear: traps catch you only on a roll of 1 to 3).

text.success: befriend the Bramble Hare (companion: +1 die on Luck rolls at Forest locations).
text.spark: the hare has seen everyone pass; learn one tag from a rival's mission.

text.success: see the full card behind both teasers next turn.
text.fail: lost; see only 1 teaser next turn.

name: Hermit's Treehouse
teaser: A rope ladder, and a sign that says KNOCK.
flavor: A Rootkeeper hermit lives up here and teaches only visitors who earn it.

text.success: gain 2 Lessons in any one stat.
gain 2 Lessons in Wits and see the next World card.
text.fail: he slams the door; lose 1 stamina.
text.spark: he also gives you a Lucky Thimble (reroll up to 2 dice once per game).

name: The Singing Stump
teaser: Someone is humming inside a hollow log.
flavor: A stump that sings old Gardener-King songs. Thal pools in its rings.

text.success: restore all stamina and gain 1 Spark token.
text.spark: gain a permanent quirk, Stump-Voiced (+1 die on Charm at Forest locations, -1 die on Wits at Ruins locations).

spark.name: Stump-Voiced
spark.text: +1 die on Charm at Forest locations, -1 die on Wits at Ruins locations

name: Owlbeard's Parliament
teaser: Many eyes, all of them judging.
flavor: The owls of the deep wood hold court at dusk and don't like interruptions.

text.success: befriend Judge Owlbeard (companion: once per game, see a rival's chosen card before reveal).
text.fail: banished; lose 1 stamina and see only 1 teaser next turn.
text.spark: the owls also tell you one tag from a rival's mission.

name: Heart of the Old Grove
teaser: The trees here are older than kings.
flavor: The trees closest to the Great Thalowood drink the most thal, and they guard it jealously.

text.spark: also a Sapling of the Eldest (gear: +1 max stamina for the rest of the game).

text.success: gain 3 Lessons in one stat and 1 Spark token.
text.fail: the grove pushes back; lose 2 health and 2 stamina.

name: The Thalowood Roots
teaser: The ground hums, and it's coming from below.
flavor: Where the roots of the Great Thalowood Tree break the surface, the air shimmers with raw thal.

text.spark: also a Taproot Fragment (legendary; effect hidden until used).

text.success: see the next 2 World cards and learn one tag from a rival's mission.

name: Wyrmwood Thicket
teaser: Claw marks, very fresh.
flavor: Something big sharpens its claws on these trees. This is its home.

text.success: befriend the Thornback Bear (companion: +2 dice on Brawn rolls; flees if you take 2 or more damage in one turn).
gain 5 coin from the bear's hoard.

name: Buttercup Hill
teaser: Bright, open, and suspiciously cheerful.
flavor: Wildflowers bob in a breeze that isn't there. The pollen makes everyone a little dreamy.

text.success: Restore 3 stamina. Roll 1 die: on a 6, a pollen dream shows you the next World card.

name: Firefly Fields
teaser: Little lights everywhere.
flavor: At dusk, the fireflies here glow with drops of thal.

text.fail: lost in the dark; see only 1 teaser next turn.
text.spark: see the full card behind both teasers next turn.

name: The Beehive Orchard
teaser: Buzzing. So much buzzing.
flavor: Thal-fed bees make honey that glows faintly and tastes like summer.

text.spark: also a Honey Cake (food: restore 3 stamina).

text.success: befriend Buzzbelle (companion: +1 die on Charm rolls at Meadow locations).
text.spark: Buzzbelle also brings royal jelly worth 3 coin.

name: Scarecrow Crossing
teaser: The scarecrow turned its head.
flavor: An old scarecrow at the crossroads gives directions. They're usually right.

text.success: draw 3 teasers next turn and pick 1.
text.fail: it lies; see only 1 teaser next turn.
text.spark: it saw your rivals pass; learn one tag from a rival's mission.

text.success: Lucky Button (gear: reroll 1 die once per game).

name: Moonpetal Meadow
teaser: These flowers only open at night.
flavor: Pale flowers that drink moonlight and glow until dawn.

text.success: see the next World card and gain 1 Spark token.
text.fail: you sleepwalk and lose your quick action this turn.
text.spark: you dream a rival's secret; learn one tag from their mission.

name: The Pollen Storm
teaser: The air is gold and thick.
flavor: When the meadow sneezes, everyone sees strange things.

text.success: Golden Pollen Pouch (4 / 2) and 1 Spark token.
text.spark: gain a permanent quirk, Pollen-Touched (+1 die on Spark at Meadow locations, -1 die on Brawn at Mountain locations).

spark.name: Pollen-Touched
spark.text: +1 die on Spark at Meadow locations, -1 die on Brawn at Mountain locations

text.fail: you hallucinate; see only 1 teaser next turn.
text.spark: also learn one tag from a rival's mission.

name: Gilly the Giant Goose
teaser: HONK.
flavor: A goose as tall as a house guards a golden nest and fears nothing.

mishap.text: gain a permanent quirk, Goose-Shy (-1 die on any roll at a Creature location).

effects.name: Goose-Shy
effects.text: -1 die on any roll at a Creature location

text.success: befriend Gilly (companion: +2 dice when a rival Brawls you).
text.spark: she lays you a Golden Goose Egg as a gift.

text.success: Goose-Down Pillow (gear: rest options restore 1 extra stamina) and 2 coin.

name: The Fairy Ring
teaser: Mushrooms in a perfect circle.
flavor: Step inside, and the Bloom feels very close.

mishap.text: you're a frog until your next turn.

text.success: gain 2 Spark tokens and 1 Lesson in Charm.
text.fail: you dance all night; lose 2 stamina.
text.spark: also a Fairy Charm (redraw both explore teasers once, then it's gone).

text.fail: the fairies take a random item.

name: The Thistle Knights' Tourney
teaser: Banners, trumpets, and a lot of shouting.
flavor: The Thistle Knights hold a tourney every Bloom. Anyone may enter. Few walk away.

text.spark: also a Thistle Banner (gear: +1 die on Charm rolls).

name: The Dreaming Field
teaser: Everyone who sleeps here dreams the same dream.
flavor: Thal pollen hangs so thick that dreams spill into the waking world.

text.fail: you can't wake; skip your next explore but keep your items.

text.success: take a random item from the rival holding the most items.
text.spark: also learn one tag from that rival's mission.

text.success: Restore all stamina, then roll 1 die: on a 1 or 2, a nightmare costs you 2 health.

name: The Moth Queen's Court
teaser: Soft wings in the dark, thousands of them.
flavor: The Moth Queen rules the night meadow, and she is very tired.

text.success: befriend a Moon Moth (companion and light source: +1 die on Spark rolls).
text.fail: the swarm is annoyed; lose 2 health.

name: The Giggling Bog
teaser: Something laughs beneath the mud.
flavor: The mud here giggles when you step in it. A troll is stuck to his waist, glaring, and a tiny light bobs in the fog.

mishap.text: you're a frog until your next turn.

text.fail: the mud swallows a random item.

text.success: befriend Grumblewort (companion: +1 die on Brawn rolls for 3 turns).
text.spark: he whispers one tag from a rival's mission.

text.success: Starlit Lantern (light source; 6 / 3) and see the next World card.
text.fail: lost in the fog; see only 1 teaser next turn.
text.spark: the wisp stays (companion and light source: +1 die on Wits rolls).

text.success: Restore 3 stamina. Roll 1 die: on a 1, a frog steals a random item.

name: Lily Pad Crossing
teaser: Stepping stones that aren't stones.
flavor: Giant lily pads float across the bog. Some of them are frogs.

text.success: learn one tag from a rival's mission.
text.fail: they ribbit at you; nothing happens.
text.spark: befriend Sir Croaksworth (companion: you can't be turned into a frog).

text.success: Restore 2 stamina. Roll 1 die: on a 1, you're a frog until your next turn.

name: The Mudlark Market
teaser: Someone's selling things out of the mud.
flavor: Mudlarks sell whatever the bog gives up, no questions asked.

text.success: sell them a good story for 3 coin.
text.spark: also a Mud Map (see the full card behind both teasers next turn).

text.success: learn one tag from a rival's mission.
text.fail: they gossip about you; a random rival learns one tag from your mission.

name: Toadstool Thicket
teaser: Spotted caps, taller than you.
flavor: Giant mushrooms ferment thal into something fizzy and unpredictable.

text.success: Fizzcap (food: +2 dice on your next roll, then lose 1 health).
text.fail: wrong cap; you're a frog until your next turn.

name: The Frog King's Court
teaser: Tiny crowns. So many tiny crowns.
flavor: A court of frogs ruled by a very small, very serious king.

text.success: the Frog King's Favor (once per game, turn a rival into a frog until their next turn).
text.fail: you're a frog until your next turn.
text.spark: also befriend Prince Ribbon (companion: +1 die on Charm rolls at Swamp locations).

text.fail: the court pelts you; lose 2 health.

text.success: You're a frog until your next turn. Gain 1 Lesson in Charm.

name: Witchlight Marsh
teaser: Green lights bobbing over black water.
flavor: Will-o'-wisps lead travelers astray, or somewhere wonderful.

text.fail: led astray; see only 1 teaser next turn.
text.spark: also befriend a wisp (companion and light source: +1 die on Wits rolls).

options.name: Catch a Wisp in a Jar

name: The Sunken Chapel
teaser: A bell tolls underwater.
flavor: A Gardener-King chapel, half sunk in the bog. Something still rings the bell.

text.success: the Sunken Crown (8 / 4), or a Drowned Reliquary (6 / 3) if the crown has already been found.
see the next World card and gain 1 Spark token.
text.spark: also learn one tag from a rival's mission.

name: Gator Ferry
teaser: The ferryman has a lot of teeth.
flavor: An enormous gator ferries travelers across the deep bog. He sets the fee.

text.success: Restore 2 stamina, and draw 3 teasers next turn and pick 1.
a free ride, plus 3 coin he found in the river.
text.spark: also befriend Captain Snapjaw (companion: +1 die on Brawn rolls at Swamp locations).

name: The Drowned Throne
teaser: A throne, rising from the water.
flavor: The Drowned King's throne still sits in the deepest pool, and his ghost still sits on it.

text.fail: the ghost drags you down; lose 3 health.

text.success: he trades you the Sunken Crown for a promise.
text.fail: cursed; add 1 Trouble die to your next roll.
text.spark: also learn one tag from a rival's mission.

name: The Great Bog Maw
teaser: The ground is breathing.
flavor: The bog itself has a mouth here, and it's hungry.

text.success: it spits out a Maw Pearl (10 / 5).
text.fail: it keeps your treasure; lose 1 health.
text.spark: also befriend Gulp, a bog spirit (companion: once per game, ignore a trap you spring).

name: The Fermenting Deep
teaser: Bubbles. Big ones.
flavor: The deepest part of the bog, where thal ferments into something wild and dangerous.

text.success: Bottled Thal Brew (food: +3 dice on your next roll; if that roll Mishaps, lose 2 health).
text.fail: it explodes; lose 2 health and you're a frog until your next turn.

text.success: gain 3 Lessons in Spark and restore all stamina.
text.fail: lose 3 health and gain a permanent quirk, Bubbly (+1 die on Spark at Swamp locations, -1 die on Wits rolls).

fail.name: Bubbly
fail.text: +1 die on Spark at Swamp locations, -1 die on Wits rolls

name: Goatpath Switchbacks
teaser: A narrow path, and a goat that refuses to move.
flavor: Mountain goats know every path, and they charge a toll.

text.success: befriend Biscuit the goat (companion: +1 die on rolls at Mountain locations).

name: Echo Gorge
teaser: Say something. It'll say something back.
flavor: The gorge repeats your words, sometimes with useful additions.

text.success: learn one tag from a rival's mission.
text.fail: the echo mocks you; lose 1 stamina.
text.spark: also see the next World card.

name: Alpine Hot Springs
teaser: Steam rising from the snow.
flavor: Thal-warmed springs that heal tired adventurers. The marmots got here first.

text.success: befriend a marmot (companion: +1 die on Luck rolls at Mountain locations).

name: The Kite Cliffs
teaser: Wind, and a very long drop.
flavor: Cloud-kite racers launch from here every Bloom.

text.success: gain 4 coin, and draw 3 teasers next turn and pick 1.
Restore 1 stamina. You may bet 2 coin and roll 1 die: on a 5 or 6, gain 6 coin.

name: Frostroot Caves
teaser: Roots frozen into crystal.
flavor: Deep inside these caves, mountain roots freeze into glittering crystal.

text.success: gain 2 coin and see the full card behind both teasers next turn.
text.fail: lost; see only 1 teaser next turn.

name: The Stone Giant's Toes
teaser: These boulders have toenails.
flavor: A sleeping stone giant lies half buried in the mountain. Don't tickle it.

text.success: the giant laughs and coughs up a Giant's Gallstone (6 / 3).
befriend Pebble, the giant's rock-hound (companion: once per game, ignore all damage from a Brawl).
text.spark: the giant tells you a secret; learn one tag from a rival's mission.

text.success: gain 2 coin and see the next 2 World cards.

name: Thunderhead Pass
teaser: The clouds are low and angry.
flavor: A mountain pass where thal storms gather.

text.spark: also Lightning in a Bottle (food: +3 dice on one Spark roll).
gain a permanent quirk, Static-Haired (+1 die on Spark rolls, -1 die on Charm rolls).

spark.name: Static-Haired
spark.text: +1 die on Spark rolls, -1 die on Charm rolls

text.success: Restore 1 health. See only 1 teaser next turn.

name: The Dragon's Doorstep
teaser: Something is snoring. Loudly.
flavor: The mouth of a dragon's cave. The dragon has hiccups.

name: The Summit Shrine
teaser: The air is thin, and the view is endless.
flavor: A Rootkeeper shrine at the top of the world. You can see the Great Thalowood Tree from here.

text.success: Summit Stone (8 / 4) and 1 Lesson in Brawn.
text.spark: also a Rootkeeper's Blessing (gear: +1 max health for the rest of the game).

text.success: gain 3 Lessons in any one stat.
text.spark: see the full card behind every teaser you draw for your next 3 turns.

name: Wyrmmother's Nest
teaser: Eggshells the size of wagons.
flavor: The Pickle Wyrm's mother nests here. She is not little.

text.fail: she returns; lose 3 health and a random item.

text.success: befriend a Wyrmling (companion: +2 dice on rolls against Monster World cards).
text.spark: she also gifts you a Wyrm Scale (6 / 3).

text.success: Wyrm Scale (6 / 3) and 2 Lessons in Brawn.

name: The Toppled Archway
teaser: Old stones with old words on them.
flavor: A Gardener-King archway, carved with grafting instructions nobody can read anymore.

text.success: gain 1 Lesson in Wits and see the next World card.
text.spark: someone scratched their plans here; learn one tag from a rival's mission.

name: The Overgrown Library
teaser: Books, vines, and the smell of old paper.
flavor: Living vines have grown through every shelf. The books still whisper.

text.success: gain 2 Lessons in any one stat.
text.spark: also see the full card behind both teasers next turn.

text.fail: the vines grab you; lose 1 health.

name: The Collapsed Greenhouse
teaser: Glass everywhere, and something still growing.
flavor: A Graftwright greenhouse where grafted plants still grow strange fruit.

text.success: Grafting Shears (gear: +1 die on Wits rolls at Ruins locations).

name: The Old Well
teaser: Make a wish. Something might hear it.
flavor: A dry well from the Grafted Age. Thal still trickles at the bottom.

text.spark: also a Wishbone (redraw both explore teasers once, then it snaps).

text.fail: stuck; lose 1 stamina and see only 1 teaser next turn.

text.success: Restore 2 health. Roll 1 die: on a 1, you're a frog until your next turn.

name: The Hall of Statues
teaser: They're all looking at the same spot.
flavor: Statues of the Gardener-Kings, all staring at one stone in the floor.

text.success: gain 2 Lessons in Wits, and see the full card behind both teasers for your next 2 turns.
restore 2 stamina, and rivals can't target you this round.

name: The Grafted Garden
teaser: The topiaries are moving.
flavor: Hedge animals grafted by a Gardener-King still guard his garden.

text.success: befriend a Hedge Hound (companion: +1 die on Brawn rolls at Ruins locations).

text.fail: the hedges chase you; lose 2 stamina.
you prune the wrong one; lose 1 health.

name: The Vine-Choked Vault
teaser: A door, a lock, and a lot of vines.
flavor: A Graftwright vault, locked tight and grown over.

text.success: Set a trap on any location name for 0 stamina.

name: The Ghostly Ballroom
teaser: Music, but no musicians.
flavor: The ghosts of a Gardener-King's court still dance every Bloom.

text.fail: you can't stop dancing; lose 2 stamina.
text.spark: a ghost whispers one tag from a rival's mission.

text.fail: haunted; add 1 Trouble die to your next roll.

name: The Gardener-King's Tomb
teaser: DO NOT DISTURB, carved in six languages.
flavor: The tomb of the last Gardener-King. The vines here move like snakes.

text.spark: also a Royal Grafting Knife (gear: +1 die on any roll at Ruins locations).

text.success: gain 3 Lessons in Wits and see the next 2 World cards.
text.fail: cursed; add 1 Trouble die to your next 2 rolls.
text.spark: also learn one tag from a rival's mission.

text.success: Gain 2 Lessons in any one stat.

name: The Grafted Gate
teaser: Something is pushing from the other side.
flavor: A gate the Gardener-Kings grafted shut. It's starting to open.

text.fail: thal pushes back; lose 2 health and 2 stamina.
text.spark: gain a permanent quirk, Graft-Marked (+1 die on Spark at Ruins locations, -1 die on Charm rolls).

spark.name: Graft-Marked
spark.text: +1 die on Spark at Ruins locations, -1 die on Charm rolls

name: The Sunken Observatory
teaser: A telescope pointed straight down.
flavor: Gardener-King astronomers searched underground for the Taproot. Something found them first.

text.success: learn one tag from a rival's mission, and see the full card behind every teaser you draw for your next 3 turns.
text.fail: you see something awful; lose 2 health.

text.spark: also a Taproot Fragment (legendary; effect hidden until used).
